Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this — BeaconHealth's security team has a SIG/CAIQ follow-up specifically around access controls and ephemeral privileged access. To close a few open items in section 5.3.2 we need the following artifacts (sampled / redacted is fine):

- SCIM delta for the last 10 days limited to admin group changes (CSV preferred)
- Example SAML Assertion (redacted PII ok) showing "admin" group claim for a successful login
- JIT rotation proof for ephemeral admin accounts (rotation audit log extract)
- Evidence of privileged session sampling (screenshots or session IDs + brief notes)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the above by EOD Aug 13 Pacific? If not, please propose a cutoff and what you can deliver by then.

Also: Beacon's team would like confirmation that service accounts referenced by those admin groups underwent a least-privilege review in the last 90 days (names or IDs and reviewer notes are sufficient).

Thanks,
Kelsey
AssureSec — Security Assurance Analyst

Hi all — we can deliver everything Kelsey requested by EOD Aug 13 PST. Here's the proposed deliverable set and format: 

1) SCIM delta (attachment: scim-delta-admins-20260801-20260810.csv) — CSV with columns: externalId, userName, operation (create/update/delete), groupMembership(before), groupMembership(after), timestamp, changedBy. Will include only admin-group related rows and strip email local-parts (keep domain) for privacy.

2) SAML assertion sample (attachment: saml-assertion-sample-redacted.xml) — single successful assertion with SubjectNameID redacted, preserved <AttributeStatement> entries including group claim and AssertionConsumerService information. Signed metadata preserved.

3) JIT rotation log (attachment: jit-rotation-log-20260810.txt) — trimmed log showing ephemeral admin lease issuance and revocation events with requestor ID, lease duration, KMS key thumbprint reference. We will redact long-lived session tokens.

4) Privileged session sampling (attachment: privileged-session-snapshots.zip) — 3 redacted snapshots + small index mapping session ID -> timestamp -> justification. Full recordings are sensitive; we will provide snapshots plus session IDs and an internal ticket reference for audit if Beacon needs playback (subject to NDA).

5) Least-privilege review summary (inline doc included in the index) — list of service account IDs referenced in admin groups and date of last review + reviewer initials.

Delivery plan: initial package (1,2,5 plus index) by EOD Aug 12 PST; full package including logs + snapshots by EOD Aug 13 PST. If Beacon needs anything earlier, we can prioritize the SCIM delta CSV for same-day delivery.

I'll attach the files to the delivery email and place a copy on the shared Drive link.

Attachments (will be included in the package): scim-delta-admins-20260801-20260810.csv, saml-assertion-sample-redacted.xml, jit-rotation-log-20260810.txt, privileged-session-snapshots.zip

Marcus Lin

Perfect — thanks for the clear plan and the early delivery option. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- SCIM CSV: account add/remove + timestamp is fine (no need for full attribute diffs).
- SAML assertion: redaction approach sounds good — please keep the Issuer and SignatureMethod intact.
- Privileged sessions: snapshots + session IDs + index will do. We'll escalate for playback only if we need root-cause evidence (we understand NDA constraints).
- Least-privilege review: can you include reviewer initials + link to the reviewer ticket/PR for traceability? Beacon's compliance reviewer uses that to close the loop.

One more ask: could you map each delivered artifact to the CAIQ control IDs (example: CCM_5.3.2 -> scim-delta-admins-20260801-20260810.csv) in the index file? That will speed validation on their side.

If you can get the index + SCIM CSV by EOD Aug 12 PST, Beacon should be able to close the SIG item without the session snapshots; otherwise we'll wait for the full package on the 13th.

Thanks again — look forward to the Drive link.

—Kelsey
AssureSec
